title: Supabase PostgreSQL
outcome: Operate Supabase as managed PostgreSQL with deliberate project, connection, pooling, dashboard, and environment boundaries.
artifact: A Supabase project configured for TaskFlow development with documented connection paths and safe environment variables.
labSteps: Create the project and record which values are public identifiers versus secrets.
Inspect the database with SQL editor and an external client so the dashboard is not the only access path.
Compare direct and pooled connection strings and document when each is appropriate.
Place connection information in environment files excluded from Git.
Test connectivity from the API environment and diagnose a deliberately incorrect host/port/password.
Document how local, staging, and production projects will remain separate.
failureModes: Using the wrong connection mode for serverless/concurrent workloads
Treating dashboard clicks as schema migration history
Pointing preview environments at production data
mastery: Can explain direct vs pooled connections
Can identify public vs secret Supabase values
principles: Treat Supabase Postgres as PostgreSQL first; managed services do not remove relational design responsibilities.
Separate connection details, credentials, and environment configuration from source code.
Understand pooling and connection limits before scaling application instances.
Use the Supabase dashboard as an operational tool, not as a substitute for migrations and repeatable schema changes.
